stories.title: Grand Haven and Spring Lake renew a 37-year-old football rivalry to fund cancer retreats for local families
stories.summary: For their first varsity meeting in 37 years, Grand Haven and Spring Lake turned the game into a fundraiser for Bluebird Cancer Retreats, selling yard signs toward a $20,000 goal for free family camps. Spring Lake mom Krista Brennfoerder shares how Bluebird and her neighbors carried her family through breast cancer.
stories.extended_summary: The Spring Lake Lakers and Grand Haven Buccaneers met on August 27, 2026, the first varsity matchup between the neighboring towns in 37 years. Grand Haven's annual BUCS Pride game raised money through community yard sign sales and direct gifts for Bluebird Cancer Retreats of West Michigan, which offers free retreats, support groups, family camps and care bags to people facing cancer. Days before kickoff, about $6,000 of the $20,000 goal had been raised. Krista Brennfoerder, a mother of three Spring Lake students, was diagnosed with breast cancer at 40 in 2023. Friends sat with her through chemotherapy and arranged childcare, the Jeffers Parent Organization raked her lawn, and other parents delivered meals and care baskets. Bluebird hosted her at an individual retreat and then her whole family at Family Camp. "The whole family feels cancer," she said.
